title: Flight 19 and the lost PBY from Banana River
summary: Greg Rogers tells of Flight 19 and the lost PBY from Banana River, about 1945 at The Bermuda Triangle, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Banana River Naval Air Station (later Patrick AFB), Florida / Bermuda Triangle

tellings.quote: I talked to some of the guys that were in flight ops on that day

plain: Greg Rogers, a doctor who has worked with NASA, the US space agency, talks about Flight 19, a group of Navy planes lost in 1945 in the Bermuda Triangle, a stretch of ocean off Florida known for disappearances, and a PBY, a Navy seaplane, that went missing from Banana River Naval Air Station, later Patrick Air Force Base. He says he spoke with men who were working flight operations there that day. Their accounts matter because they would be firsthand memories of one of the most famous vanishings at sea.
